# Chorded input (CharaChorder path)

Chords arrive as machine-fast words over plain HID — no driver. The vocabulary is prefix-free, so a known word commits on its last keystroke (⚡, IPA 1, TTC ≈ 0). The same word typed slowly still works, flagged ⌨ at honest cost. Select with the pointer, act with the chord.
